snippets.snippet_text: "To receive a payout, you must have a minimum balance of US $10. Certain countries have higher minimum payout balances - Thailand (600 THB) and Korea (40,000 KRW)."
"Each payout is for sales made up to the previous Friday UTC. This means that the sale amount sits in your Gumroad balance for at least 7 days before being paid out."
"PayPal payouts are always processed in USD, and usually in 1-3 business days."
"All currency conversions happen based on the exchange rates at the time of sale, not at the time of the payout. These are typically mid-market rates that you can estimate here."
